business_problem: Avalara's legacy SQL estate ran in a single cloud and region, making it difficult to scale a rapidly growing tax-compliance platform, meet low-latency expectations, satisfy data-sovereignty requirements, and give customers cloud choice.
solution_summary: Avalara rearchitected Project Polaris on MongoDB Atlas to replace its legacy SQL stack with a more resilient, multi-cloud tax-compliance platform. Starting in 2021, the team split a monolithic frontend and backend into microservices and made Atlas the foundational data layer. Billions of documents were migrated cohort by cohort using dual writes, data-quality checks, and zero-downtime cutovers so customer operations stayed intact during the changeover. The resulting platform runs across Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Azure, with analytics nodes serving live transaction reporting and change streams driving event-based workflows. Avalara is also validating MongoDB Search on Atlas and MongoDB Vector Search on Atlas for hybrid search, retrieval-augmented generation, contextualization, and activity-stream scenarios, while a later Active-Active program extends the same architecture for high availability, disaster recovery, and regional expansion.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Acts as the core document database for Avalara's rearchitected tax-compliance platform and supports the microservices migration.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Search on Atlas
solution_components.role: Supports Avalara's proof of concept for hybrid search and contextual retrieval workloads.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Vector Search on Atlas
solution_components.role: Adds semantic retrieval for Avalara's AI-oriented search and activity-stream experiments.

data_flow: Legacy SQL data is migrated into MongoDB Atlas through staged dual-write cutovers, tax transaction services read and write operational documents in Atlas, analytics nodes power customer-facing reporting, change streams trigger event-driven workflows, and newer search and vector indexes are being tested for retrieval, contextualization, and AI-assisted experiences.
business_outcome: Avalara cut end-to-end tax transaction latency from 500 milliseconds to under 150 milliseconds, reached 99.99% uptime with multi-cloud redundancy, reduced technical debt and license costs, and sped up delivery of new tax engines.
